home.intro: Connect a printer. Give your network a print button.
home.standby_body: Choose a paired Bluetooth or connected USB printer to get started.
home.ready_body: Your printer is selected. Start the server to accept print jobs.
home.listening_body: Listening for raw print jobs on your local network.
home.failed_body: Stop the server to finish cleanup before trying again.
home.device_hint: Find a paired Bluetooth printer or a compatible USB printer connected through an Android OTG adapter.
home.no_printers_help: Scan for a paired Bluetooth printer or a connected USB OTG printer.
home.select_device_hint: Opens the list of discovered Bluetooth and USB printers
home.usb_bulk_hint: USB OTG sends raw bytes to a bulk OUT endpoint. Some printer-class devices work if they accept raw bytes. Generic print drivers or spoolers, IPP, and USB serial are not supported.
home.usb_issue_help: Check the OTG adapter and printer connection, then try the USB scan again.
home.usb_detached: The USB printer is no longer connected. Reconnect it and scan again.
home.printer_issue_help: Allow Nearby devices and turn on Bluetooth in Android settings, then try again.
home.discovery_failed: Could not find paired printers. Check Bluetooth and permissions, then retry.
home.settings_unavailable: Could not open Android settings. Open them manually and select PrintDock.
home.network_hint: Use the same trusted network as your point-of-sale device.
home.start_hint: Requires an available printer, a valid port and a local network address
home.local_description: Connect your POS over TCP. PrintDock forwards raw bytes to your Bluetooth or USB bulk printer.
home.network_safety_detail: This port has no authentication or encryption. Anyone who can reach it can send print jobs. Never expose it to the internet.
home.unsupported_detail: Bluetooth and USB OTG print serving are available on Android. This platform is not supported yet.

error_boundary.title: Oops! Something went wrong.
error_boundary.description: We are sorry for the inconvenience. Please try again later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make PrintDock feel like yours.
settings.appearance_hint: Choose a comfortable look for your workspace.
settings.language_hint: Changes apply immediately and stay saved on this device.
settings.about_description: A focused bridge between your local network and a Bluetooth or USB bulk receipt printer.
settings.protocol_note: PrintDock uses raw TCP, Bluetooth Classic SPP, and USB OTG bulk OUT. Some printer-class devices accept raw bytes. Generic print drivers or spoolers, IPP, USB serial, and Apple's AirPrint are not supported.

print_server.network_changed: Network address changed. Restart the server to update its displayed endpoint.

print_server.invalid_start_config: Select an available printer, enter a valid port, and connect to a network before starting.

print_server.confirm_stop: Allow an external link to stop the running server?
print_server.subtitle: Bluetooth Thermal Print Server
print_server.please_select_device: Please select an available printer first.
print_server.permission_required: Bluetooth permissions are required to list devices.
print_server.server_started: Print server started in the background.
